spec.name: GoldZScoreSessionMomentum
spec.hypothesis: Gold exhibits persistent intraday momentum during London and NY sessions due to institutional order flow clustering around key macroeconomic releases and central bank activity. When price deviates significantly from its session VWAP (measured via Z-Score), it often signals the start of a sustained directional move rather than mean reversion, as large players are actively accumulating or distributing positions. Retail traders expecting reversion become trapped on the wrong side, providing fuel for continuation. This edge exploits the asymmetry between retail mean-reversion bias and institutional trend initiation during high-liquidity windows.
spec.entry_logic: Enter long when Z-Score of close relative to session VWAP crosses above +1.0 AND vol_percentile > 30 AND within London/NY session. Enter short when Z-Score crosses below -1.0 under same conditions. Requires confirmation that ATR is valid and positive.
spec.exit_logic: Stop loss set at max(5.0, 1.8 * ATR). Take profit set at max(7.5, 2.8 * ATR) to maintain positive expectancy with ~60% win rate target.
filters: Volatility percentile > 30 to avoid dead zones
spec.expected_failure_conditions: Extended low-volatility regimes where Z-Score fails to reach threshold; Asian-session-dominated weeks with no London/NY participation

details.detail: Bit-identical signal tapes produced on two independent runs with seed=42.
Verified signal identity T_c[0..c] == T_full[0..c] across 20 cut points (tolerance 1e-9).
